Trust Center

Certifications

  • SOC 2 Type II (audit period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31)
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022
  • HITRUST CSF v11 certified

Healthcare Customers

Aegis Identity Cloud executes a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with covered entities and business associates on Enterprise and Healthcare plans. The BAA covers the Workforce Identity and Customer Identity services and the subprocessors listed on our subprocessor page.

Artificial Intelligence

Access Copilot. Access Copilot is powered by a large language model hosted by Aegis in our own cloud environment. Prompts and responses are processed in the customer's assigned region.

  • Training: Customer data is not used to train foundation models. We do not currently publish a statement covering fine-tuning on aggregated telemetry.
  • Model provider: Aegis does not disclose the underlying model vendor for Access Copilot.
  • Human review: All Copilot suggestions require administrator approval before taking effect.
  • Logging: Copilot interactions appear in the System Log as copilot.query events.
  • Retention: Prompt retention period is under review; contact your account team for specifics.

Data Residency

Customer data is stored in the region selected at org creation: US, EU, or APAC. Copilot inference runs in-region.

Incident Response

Security incidents are reported to affected customers within 72 hours of confirmation, per the DPA. Our incident response plan is available under NDA.
